question: What ritual quantity must be accomplished at the forehead syllable mass by the god-worshipped practitioner?
premises: Kaula teaching is not given to everyone
Its extraction remains secret and fixed
Forehead syllable mass practice requires hundred thousand repetitions
inference: The practitioner must complete one hundred thousand acts at the forehead syllable mass.
uncertainties: Exact referent of lakṣaṃ is unspecified
Grammatical case of sura+arcite is unclear
plain_english: Having done one hundred thousand acts situated in the forehead syllable mass, O god-worshipped one.
